cards.name: Ghazbán Ogre
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if a player has more life than each other player, the player with the most life gains control of this creature.

cards.name: Ghazbán Ogress
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, if one player has won more Magic games that day than any other player, that player gains control of this creature.
